title: Determine the pancake numbers
formal: Determine f(n), the maximum over permutations of n symbols of the minimum number of prefix reversals needed to put the permutation in sorted order, for arbitrary n.
context:
This asks for the extremal function over all permutations, not the complexity of finding an optimal sequence for one given permutation.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A canonical extremal problem about the power of restricted sorting operations.
